title: Ariana Grande Promotes R.E.M Beauty Blur Butter with Harry Potter Impressions
text:
Ariana Grande showcases her voice skills and unique marketing approach by promoting R.E.M Beauty Blur Butter through Harry Potter impressions.
Ariana Grande promotes R.E. M Beauty Blur Butter through Harry Potter impressions, showcasing her voice skills and unique marketing approach. The singer, who launched her beauty brand in 2021, has also lent her voice to characters in various projects.
Grande's Harry Potter impressions feature memorable lines with mentions of the product, setting a new trend in marketing. Fans praised her voice skills and smart promotion, with some comparing her to a 'true icon vocal miracle'. The brand's name, R.E. M, is a tribute to her 2018 song from the album Sweetener, and its name is also inspired by the concept of rapid eye movement, which focuses on dreams and the eyes.
Grande's passion for cinema led her into entertainment journalism, and she has a fondness for the Marvel Cinematic Universe, psychological thrillers, horror, and films with profound philosophical undertones
